entries.text: “You are not alone” is such a good place to start 💛 Lovely to see you sharing the Wandering Minds Collective and helping people find one another.
Melissa, a little basket with stories to share sounds like a lovely start to spooky season 🎃📚 The books would be the first thing I’d reach for!
Maricel, me quedo con ese «cómo estás» honesto, con quedarse de verdad a escuchar la respuesta. Gracias por recordarlo entre tus letras. Te mando un abrazo ❤️
Michael, I liked your note about making the step smaller if the first try feels too much. There’s a lot of kindness in leaving room to change the plan together 💚
Being able to change your mind about what you’ve shared matters so much. I appreciate seeing the delete option explained plainly, without making people hunt for it 💚

entries.text: Edu, me ha gustado mucho esa parte de las canciones que nos devuelven a alguien. Basta escuchar el comienzo para que aparezca un recuerdo entero ❤️🎶
Ornella, I’m glad there are people beside you when the workload feels heavy. The way you thanked your team and everyone helping came through so warmly. Sending you a hug for the hard days too 💛
Monique, I’m glad you left room for laughter alongside the hard parts. A shared silly moment can be such a welcome breather 💛
Sanjana, the little teeth rescue mission made me smile 🦷💛 You’ve given them so many things to discover in one tray, and I love the note you leave for Ash and Amara at the end.
Britt, the bright pink saber is perfect for this one 🩷 Love that you’re bringing people’s song requests to life!
The idea of sending the package to someone else is lovely 💕 A little surprise that says “I was thinking of you”.
I love that an ordinary, quiet day is allowed to be enough here 🤍 And that tiny reading room inside the teacup is such a sweet detail.
Shelly, B. Att’s five-star review made me laugh 😂🦇 “Didn’t hear use your words once” — I can see why he’s a happy client!
Talia, choosing her own tomatoes and then stopping for the swings — what a lovely day for Alisa 🍅❤️ I love that you came home with both the vegetables and that happy memory. A big hug to you both!
entries.note: Corrección: talia_alisa es otra cuenta de la misma persona; se revisó separadamente.

entries.text: Susana, una lata con forma de libro es una tentación doble 😂📚 De esas que después da gusto guardar para los pequeños tesoros. ¡Gracias por el aviso!
Tania, me alegra ver a la familia incluida en esa conversación desde el principio. Que alguien escuche lo que observan en casa y les explique los siguientes pasos con calma también importa mucho 💛
The words about never measuring Blake’s worth by comparisons really stayed with me ❤️ So much love in that promise. Sending a big hug to you both.
Mia and Zac sound like the best little adventure team 💙🩷 Sunshine, animals and sibling silliness — lovely memories to bring home from the holidays!

entries.text: La imagen de los centímetros que sobran al final cierra muy bien el texto. Has ido creando esa tensión frase a frase 🖤
I’m glad you included acknowledging challenges in this list 💛 Encouraging words feel kinder when there’s room to say that something is hard, too.

Tomás, esa pregunta sobre qué tiene que perder un personaje para que lo acepten me ha dejado pensando. Me interesa escuchar también cómo lo entienden los niños cuando llegamos a ese final. Gracias por abrir la conversación 📚💛
Toni, qué alegría verte acompañando a Amparo en una presentación tan arropada. Leer ese primer capítulo ante la librería llena debió de ser emocionante. Un abrazo y enhorabuena a los dos ❤️📚
Gracias por abrir este espacio para compartir experiencias de maternidad y paternidad 💙 Que las familias tengan un lugar donde contar su historia y encontrarse con otras merece mucho cuidado.
Me gusta que la conversación empiece con algo tan cotidiano como elegir un color. Poder decir «me gusta este» sin tener que justificarse ya es mucho 🌈💛 Gracias por acercarnos el cuento.
That detail about an ordinary goodbye becoming the last one is so tender. It makes me want to be a little more present in the moments we do get together 🤍
Usha, sending some kindness to everyone living with persistent pain who comes across this conversation 🤍 Being listened to and taken seriously matters so much.
Vane, qué ilusión imaginar a Clara saliendo del kamishibai y encontrándose con todas esas preguntas de los peques 🦋 Tres ciudades y tantas historias para llevarte tú también. ¡Enhorabuena, bonita! ❤️
Georgi, stepping away doesn’t undo the connections you’ve made here 💚 Lovely to see you again, and I hope there’s been plenty of sky and fresh air between the screen time.
Sam, those two empty chairs beside the sea make the first lines feel even lonelier. You’ve put a painful change into very few words. Sending you a hug 🤍

entries.text: Yana, I like how the ending keeps moving towards someone, gently and hopefully. There’s a lovely patience in these lines 🤍
Me quedo pensando en ese espacio entre despedir una etapa y abrirse a otra. Ojalá nos demos también tiempo para atravesarlo, sin exigirnos estar preparados enseguida 💛

Harriett, I love that you see the garden as the beginning of cooking 🌿 There’s something lovely about following what you’ve grown all the way to the plate. Thank you for sharing your flowers with us, too 💛

entries.text: Roge, me gusta que lo cuentes así de claro: reconocer una buena prosa y decir que la historia no te ha emocionado. Se agradece leer lo que realmente te ha pasado con el libro ❤️
Malou, that line about sharing playlists feels so close to sending someone a little piece of yourself 💜 “This made me think of you” can say so much with just one song. A big hug, my friend 🎶
That precious time together is a lovely thing to carry into a new month 🧡 The small moments deserve a place in the memories, too.

entries.text: Amy, that wish to give her independence while still being there for her comes through so clearly. Growing into this stage together brings plenty of new conversations 💛
Anabella, ese comienzo de creer que mamá puede con todo toca muy cerca. Qué bonito dedicarle una carta de amor también a la persona que hay detrás de esa fuerza ❤️

entries.text: Someone being able to say “I don’t know” helps me trust them. I like this reminder to pause before mistaking a confident answer for a reliable one 🤍
Caty, me encanta que nos enseñes también cómo trabajas la pasta y le das color. Viéndote entran ganas de preparar una tarjeta de otoño y ponerse manos a la obra 🍂🧡 Un abrazo, bonita.

Dorit, that little house in the tree with its colourful windows made me smile ❤️ I love seeing the early drawings you’ve kept, and that you’re still proud of where your squirrel began. A big hug, my friend 🐿️

Aida, te mando un abrazo muy grande, bonita 🤍 Siento que hoy esté siendo tan difícil. No tienes que estar alegre ni encontrar las palabras perfectas para merecer cariño. Ojalá hoy puedas descansar y sentirte acompañada.
That wish to help a child make their own decisions is such a tender part of parenting ❤️ Giving them room to try, with someone kind beside them, matters so much.
¡Sugey, qué ambientazo con toda esa banda en el escenario! 🎶❤️ Espero que disfrutaras muchísimo de la noche y de cantar tus favoritas.

entries.note: Última6/9; comentario Iris de3semanas visible. Sin duplicado.

entries.text: Jenn, “self rejection isn’t required” is the bit I’m taking with me today 🩷 We deserve some kindness while we’re figuring things out, too. Sending you a hug!

Lory, Emma’s tenth birthday and the book release on the same day — so much to celebrate 💗 Happy belated birthday to Emma, and congratulations to you! That first reading with the children must have meant a lot 📚

Kristy, a whole year of Girard! 🐌🧡 The crochet Girards, the visits, the friendships… so many lovely things from that first “share”. I’m so happy our paths crossed here. A big hug to you and happy first birthday to our little snail!
Clare, that line about supporting children to be the children they actually are says so much 🤍 Parents deserve to be listened to when they’re trying to explain what they see day after day.
Amaia, qué importante que al volver del cole encuentre una escucha tranquila y sepa que no hay nada malo en ella. Gracias por poner una situación tan concreta sobre la mesa 💛
María, bonita, qué gusto leerte contar lo que quieres compartir aquí 💛 Me encanta ese «probarlo a tu manera», dejando sitio a cada familia. Un abrazo enorme, me alegra acompañarte 🌙

entries.text: María, llego con unos días de retraso, pero con mucho cariño: ¡felices dos añitos a tu pequeña! ❤️ Qué bonito que hables también de lo que ella te está enseñando a ti. Un abrazo enorme a las dos 🎂
Ali, “Bee Spooky” and “Bee Kind” make such a sweet pair 👻🐝🧡 Wishing you and your little explorers a month full of colourful, giggly adventures!
Shane, I’m glad the Tagalog cards include feelings alongside animals and body parts 💛 Those everyday words make room for so much conversation while you sit and explore together.

Rowena, that distinction between a photo as a record and a photo that’s been changed gives us plenty to talk about at home. I appreciate you making room for the “would we use it?” conversation as well as the feature itself 💛
Those unplanned connections, and the little moments that stay with us 🩵 Such a warm thought to share together.
Sending you a big hug, Natalia 🤍 All that chasing while caring for Ignacy is so much to carry. Thinking of you both.
“I don’t remember. But it was necessary.” 😂 That defence is airtight, Gini!
“You can be strong & still accept help” — keeping that line close, Bea 💙 There’s room for all of it.
“A lifetime” carries so much in this design 💛 Thank you for giving those years of masking words people can see.

entries.text: So much of that constant checking is invisible, Lou ❤️ Sending you a big hug after this morning. Glad more support is on its way for you both.
Qué buena idea trabajar una misma opinión desde A1 hasta C2, Béatrice 😍 Da curiosidad ver cuánto cambia la forma de expresarla.
That wave and “bye” for his grandparents 🥹💛 What a lovely memory to have of Tommy and Arthur together.
After a whole summer of stations, the Flying Scotsman sounds like quite a finale 😂🚂 Lovely that the team made it so memorable for the boys!

entries.text: Esta frase deja pensando, Mimi… qué difícil sentir esa rabia sin quedarse a vivir en ella ❤️
Qué bonito ese ratito de charla de mamá a mamá, Susana ❤️ Y qué alegría ver a tu familia de emociones llegando a nuevos rincones 😍
A big hug to you and Myles, Terrie ❤️ Four years is so much to carry. Thank you for sharing the hard parts as honestly as you do.
That shift from feeling lonely to enjoying a little quiet, Anne 🩵 And a cup of tea that’s still hot! Glad this little online corner feels like company.
Qué alegría que Alex tenga ese ratito de piano a su manera ❤️ Qué bonito que su maestra busque cómo compartirlo con él y que termine tan feliz 😍
Esa comida de presentación ya promete lío 😂 Me gusta que destaques también a los secundarios y los límites familiares; has dejado mucha curiosidad por Alma ❤️
¡Feliz Día del Podcast a toda esa familia! ❤️ Poesía, reseñas, música… qué bonito reunir tantas voces y tantas ganas en un mismo proyecto 😍
